events.headline: 'WE ARE AT THE EDGE OF A BATTLEFIELD': BBC REPORTS NEAR STRAIT OF HORMUZ
events.detail: The BBC's Orla Guerin travels to the edge of the critical waterway that Iran has put a stranglehold on.

events.headline: TRUMP ISSUES EXPLETIVE-LADEN THREAT  TO IRAN OVER HORMUZ STRAIT BLOCKAGE
events.detail: The US president says he will destroy Iranian power plants and bridges if the vital waterway is not reopened.

events.headline: TRUMP THREATENS IRAN IN EXPLETIVE-FILLED SOCIAL MEDIA POST
events.detail: Donald Trump unleashed a vulgar online tirade against Iran’s leaders as his deadline for reopening the Strait of Hormuz.

events.headline: TRUMP THREATENS ‘HELL’ FOR IRAN OVER HORMUZ STRAIT AS DEADLINE APPROACHES
events.detail: US president threatens to strike power plants and bridges on Tuesday in an expletive-laden social media post.

events.headline: IRAN SAYS TRUMP’S ‘OPEN THE F**KIN STRAIT’ THREAT SHOWS ‘INTENT TO COMMIT WAR CR
events.detail: Tehran has said US President Trump’s latest threat to strike Iranian civilian infrastructure shows an intent to “commit war crimes” Read Full Article at RT.com

events.headline: FRENCH-OWNED SHIP PASSES THROUGH STRAIT OF HORMUZ
events.detail: It appears to be the first ship owned by a major European firm to go through the strait since the conflict began.
